title: Correct tension expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must be F₁ = mg/cosα or equivalent.

title: Correct elastic force expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must be F₂ = mg tanα or equivalent.

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply equilibrium conditions (ΣF_x = 0, ΣF_y = 0) to the point mass.

title: Proper force decomposition
description: Important Criteria: The tension force should be correctly resolved into vertical and horizontal components relative to the wall.

title: Free-body diagram implied
description: Optional Criteria: The response should indicate or imply a correct free-body diagram showing all forces.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Expressions should maintain dimensional consistency with force units.

title: Incorrect trigonometric ratio
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize swapping cosα and sinα in tension expression (e.g., F₁ = mg/sinα).

title: Missing wall force
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize omitting the wall's elastic force F₂ or treating it as zero.
